podcast.title: Demonstration of Common Chord Progressions
podcast.body: This Australian comedy group is known for demonstrating "how dozens of songs are built on the exact same four chords," highlighting that "chord progressions" are not copyrightable. "If you google Axis of Awesome, you'll find an Australian comedy group who shows how dozens of songs are built on the exact same four chords."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
